Title: interaction between Lady Scarlet Churchill and Toreador Grand ball

Messages.Author: estelmatiazi
Messages.Body:
Hello,
Lady Scarlet Churchill, from the new Fall of London set, says 'You and lady scarlett can play cards requiring a Toreador as if she were a Toreador'

Toreador Grand ball says 'Choose two ready Toreador you control, put this card in play, and lock one of the two. The locked Toreador does not unlock as normal. The other Toreador's non-bleed actions cannot be blocked. '

There has been some discussion about the interaction and wording of the cards in the discord server. My understanding is that she can be designated as the target of a Grand ball and be locked by it, making another minion unblockable, but on the next unlock phase she will unlock normally as she is no longer considered a Toreador for the effects of the card (similarly to how Mata Hari works). Is this correct?

Lasombra Archbishop of São José, SC, Brazil.

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
I was sure that LSJ answered this question at some point, but couldn't find it. Here's the rubric on how "play as-if" abilities mimic requirements.

1. Does the card have a requirement?
2. Does the vampire's play as-if ability allow them to mimic that requirement?
3. The card will see that vampire as meeting the requirement while it is played, but not while it is in play.

Toreador Grand Ball has a Toreador requirement.
Lady Scarlet can play card as-if she were a Toreador.
The TGB will see her as a Toreador if you use her to meet the requirements.

This means that Lady Scarlet is a valid choice when "choosing two ready Toreador" because if she were used to meet the requirement, she can be chosen to be one of the Toreador because TGB sees her as a Toreador. You can then choose to lock her (making her the host) or not.

In either case, once the card is in play it stops seeing Lady Scarlet as Toreador. If she were chosen as the host, she would unlock as normal because she is not seen as a Toreador when she unlocks. If she were chosen to be the guest, (you wasted the card because) she will not be seen as a Toreador and all of her actions would still be blockable.

Ideally, you play TGB with Lady Scarlet to make one Toreador's actions unblockable and ignore the long-term effects of hosting.
